cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Kremlin map data entered. Heading for the church.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Flight mode. Ascending.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Jamie, please be safe.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Remember our time limit, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Fifty years to make up for in just twelve hours.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Snow!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Snow Cedar. We've entered the Snow Cedar area.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Put on your nasal filters. Inhaling it is dangerous.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Understood.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Radio contact will be impossible from here. Ready?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Descending.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Switched to hover mode.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: We've arrived, Gillian. What now?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'll open the door.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Huh? It won't open.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: My scan shows no lock. It must be rusted shut.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Well, they come and go underground.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Let's push together.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Ready? Push! One, two, three!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: It's open.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: This is the process of covering a Snatcher's frame,

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: its endoskeleton, with artificial skin.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: First, they resize the bare Snatcher to match its victim.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Its shape and size are adjusted by extending

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: or contracting its units and slots.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: They change its sex by replacing the sex unit.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: To copy the victim's face, they adjust the upper and lower jaws,

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: cheekbones, temporal bones and teeth to match the data.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: As Gibson said, this limits the size of the people they can snatch.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: They can only expand or change shape so far.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: They can't snatch children, the elderly or large men.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Next, they cover the skeleton with muscle.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Only skeletal muscle, of course.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Is it organic?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: No. It seems to be a plastic gel

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: whose surface responds mechanically.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: It converts chemical reactions into mechanical energy.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: This is where they apply the troublesome artificial skin.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Synthetic cells made with biotechnology and protein design are

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: grafted on slowly to avoid rejection of the inorganic parts beneath.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Defective skin that turns cancerous under UV light.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Finally, they implant hair on the head and body.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: They transplant artificial hair follicle cells,

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: so the hair regrows even if it falls out.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: What about scars, blemishes and burns?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: They're added at this stage, using the victim's data.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Wrinkles and signs of age, too.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: This is where they create human replacements

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: from endoskeletons sent by the Kremlin.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Then they send them into the city through the tunnels.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: And Queen Hospital maintains their artificial skin.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: But who's behind it? And why?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Look over there, Gillian.
cues.ear_note: pitch 318 Hz = Metal Gear (Gillian 134); the script animates Gillian

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Several Snatchers are already complete.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Look! The American president!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The Japanese and British prime ministers!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: You too, Gillian!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I knew it!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: They'll attack the summit

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: and snatch every country's leaders at once!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: They intend to snatch you, the last JUNKER, and then leave the city.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Snatch the world's leaders, and the world is theirs.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: But it doesn't make sense.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Their defective artificial skin should

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: make global expansion difficult.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Chin said they'd found a way to perfect their skin.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Could something have happened?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I don't know. But look how many Snatchers there are.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: They're certainly planning something new.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: This is definitely the Snatchers' base, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Let's destroy it all!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: No! Jamie's still here! Metal, how much time is left?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: The summit has started. We're out of time.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: After the deadline, I can't help you anymore.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'll have to take you into custody.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: All right.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: If the military strikes here, what weapon will they use?

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Probably a particle beam from a killer satellite.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: A particle beam? There'll be nothing left.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Everything will vaporize. Only a huge crater will remain.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Ask them for another hour, Metal! Even thirty minutes!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Understood. I'll do what I can.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I'll rescue Jamie while you do that.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Snow Cedar makes the signal unstable here.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'll go outside the area to contact them.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: All right.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Please, Metal.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Thirty minutes, Gillian. Promise you'll come back.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I will.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: I'm sorry I couldn't be more help, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Don't worry. With no one slowing me down, thirty minutes is plenty!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Go!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Understood! Thirty minutes!

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Thirty minutes. That's tight.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Only that room left. Let's open the door.
